page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number top right above an ornamental rule. Heading block centred, then a list of numbered lines in one column. Signature at lower right of text area. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ORDO ET NVMERVS Lectionum de Cœna Domini tractantium, quæ hoc volumine comprehenduntur.
main_text.l: I. Lectio sumitur ex decimoquarto capite Marci versu duodecimo.
II. Lectio sumitur ex vigesimo secundo capite Lucæ versu decimoquarto.
III. Lectio sumitur ex decimotertio capite Ioannis versu primo & cap. decimo quarto.
IIII. Lectio sumitur ex vndecimo capite prioris ad Corinthios versu vigesimo tertio.
V. Lectio sumitur ex vigesimoquarto versu eiusdem capitis & Epistolæ.
VI. Lectio sumitur ex vigesimosexto versu eiusdem capitis & Epistolæ.
VII. Lectio sumitur ex toto loco superiori capitis vndecimi prioris ad Corinthios.

page.notes: The ornamental rule above the heading is a printer's ornament, not transcribed. Running head absent. The catchword is absent.
